numeric_tolerance.reason: Linux/Windows math libraries and Python float-sum implementation can differ in last bits; labels, counts, query membership and seed remain exact.

limitations: Local replay verifies original output/input hashes and canonical results. Bulk1M index is not duplicated locally; its hash is bound by native runtime records.
Conditional calibration comparison; shared nodes/clocks/cache and only3processes. No held-out/service-tail or external-baseline claim.
Profiler claims require separately checked exports; incomplete/failed diagnostics are retained and scoped.

1.primary: Geometric mean of pruned latency relative to full-byte, equally weighted over500queries and3processes.
limitations: Separate processes/treatment with balanced fixed orders, not a within-process three-way randomization.
SharedGPU, uncontrolledclocks/cache; only3processes, repeated calibration; no held-out/service-tail or causal cross-host conclusion.
